stamp._why: The one Welcome of MCP For Unity lives in the public plugin (AnkleBreaker-Studio/unity-mcp-plugin), so GitHub users see it too; the Asset Store package installs the plugin and keeps only CLICKME, whose inspector draws this package's hub (clickme.py host). Its own asmdef UnityMCP.Editor.Welcome references nothing, so it compiles whatever the plugin's main assembly does. Prefs keep the Asset Store package's CanonicalWelcome prefix: whoever saw that Welcome is not shown this one again. Menu under the Welcome's own name (Unity MCP), never the Asset Store package's, whose earlier Welcome registered .../MCP For Unity/Welcome until its cleanup runs.
